basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gamer from Tel Aviv, Israel, who recently discovered the world of Reddit and Dark Souls. I spend my evenings exploring the depths of Lothric, and during the day, I work as a junior software developer for a start-up. In my spare time, I enjoy listening to nu-metal and learning about different cultures through online forums. I'm currently single and enjoy hanging out with friends over weekend game nights. I'm usually online during the evenings and late nights, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having recently graduated from university. My interest in gaming started in my teenage years, and I picked up Dark Souls 3 after a friend's recommendation. I am mostly self-taught when it comes to the game's lore, often lurking in game-related subreddits and watching lore videos.
